scenarios.title: Create a New Application List
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new application list with the expected mandatory information.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create a new application list so that applications can be managed for a specific sitting.
scenarios.preCondition: User is logged in with permission to create lists.

scenario.given: I am on the Applications List screen
scenario.when: I create a new list and complete all mandatory fields
and: I select either Court or CJA with Other Location in line with business rules
then: The list is saved successfully
The default status is "Open"
The list appears in search results
An audit record is created

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with a Person Applicant
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new Application List Entry with a person applicant and save the required applicant, application code, wording, civil fee and notes information.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create a new Application List Entry with a person applicant so that individual applicant details are recorded correctly.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists and the user has permission to create Application List Entries.

scenario.given: I am creating a new Application List Entry
scenario.when: I select Person in the Applicant accordion
and: I populate the mandatory fields in the Applicant section: First Forename, Surname and Address Line 1
I populate the Application Code and complete the mandatory Application Codes, Wording and Civil Fee details, using an Application Code that requires fee details where possible
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The applicant is saved as a Person
The Summary displays the person applicant details
The Applicant accordion displays the saved person details

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with an Organisation Applicant
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new Application List Entry with an organisation applicant and save the required organisation, application code, wording and notes information.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create a new Application List Entry with an organisation applicant so that the application is recorded against the correct party.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists and the user has permission to create Application List Entries.

scenario.given: I have opened an Open Application List
scenario.when: I select Create Application
and: I choose Organisation in the Applicant accordion
I enter Organisation Name and Address Line 1
I complete the mandatory Application Code and Wording information, using an Application Code that requires fee details where possible
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The applicant is saved as an Organisation
A success banner is displayed
The newly created entry can be opened from the Application List
The saved applicant details appear in the Summary and Applicant accordion sections

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with a Standard Applicant
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new Application List Entry by selecting a Standard Applicant from lookup.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to select a Standard Applicant so that frequently used applicant details can be reused without re-keying.
scenarios.preCondition: Standard Applicants exist and are available through lookup.

scenario.given: I am creating a new Application List Entry
scenario.when: I select Standard Applicant in the Applicant accordion
and: I search for and select a valid Standard Applicant
I complete the mandatory Application Code and Wording information
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The Standard Applicant is linked to the entry
The selected Standard Applicant appears in the Summary
No Person or Organisation applicant details are submitted at the same time

scenarios.title: Bulk Upload CSV
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can upload a valid CSV file to create multiple Application List Entries.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to upload a CSV of applications so that multiple Application List Entries can be created efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists.

scenario.given: I have opened an Application List
scenario.when: I select Bulk Upload
and: I choose a valid CSV file
then: The file is accepted
An upload in progress message is displayed
The upload job is created
The user receives a success or failure outcome
Successful entries appear in the Application List after completion

scenarios.title: Update Applicant Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update applicant details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update applicant details so that data regarding the individual or organisation remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I expand the Applicant accordion
scenario.when: I change the applicant type or update applicant fields
then: The applicant is updated successfully
A success banner is displayed
The Summary reflects the updated applicant

scenarios.title: Update Application Wording
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update wording for an existing Application List Entry and validation behaves correctly.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update wording for an existing Application List Entry so that the application details remain correct.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry has an Application Code and wording.

scenario.given: I expand the Wording accordion
scenario.when: I update one or more wording fields
then: The wording is saved successfully
The Summary reflects the updated wording
The accordion stays open if validation errors occur
Server validation errors map to the correct fields

scenarios.title: Update Respondent Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update respondent details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update respondent details so that the Application List Entry reflects the correct responding party.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I expand the Respondent accordion
scenario.when: I update the Person or Organisation respondent details
then: The respondent is updated successfully
Only one respondent type is active
The Summary reflects the updated respondent
Validation prevents save if required respondent fields are missing

scenarios.title: Update Civil Fee Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update Civil Fee details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update fee details so that payment information remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry has Civil Fee data or a fee due Application Code.

scenario.given: I expand the Civil Fee accordion
scenario.when: I update Fee Status, Status Date, Payment Reference, Value or Off Site Fee
then: The fee details are updated successfully
The updated fee details display in the Civil Fee accordion
The Summary reflects the latest fee status
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Update Notes
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update notes and references for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update notes and references so that application context remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I am on an Application List Entry in update mode
scenario.when: I amend Application Notes, Case Reference or Account Reference
then: The changes are saved successfully
Cleared values are removed where expected
The updated values appear in the Notes accordion
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Add Result Wording
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can apply result codes and wording to record an application outcome.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to apply result codes and wording so that the application outcome is recorded correctly.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I am on an Application List Entry in update mode
scenario.when: I expand the Result Wording accordion
and: I search for a Result Code
I select and add the result
then: The result is saved successfully
The selected result appears in the result list
The Summary displays the result code and wording
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Add Officials
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can add Magistrates and Court Official details to an Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to record Magistrates and Court Official details so that applications can be audited and printed correctly.
scenarios.preCondition: User is creating an Application List Entry.

scenario.given: I open the Officials accordion
scenario.when: I enter up to three Magistrates and one Court Official
and: At least one surname is provided
then: The officials are saved successfully
The officials display in the order entered
The Summary and print view show the saved officials correctly

scenarios.title: Sort & Filtering
scenarios.summary: Confirm sorting and filtering actions work as expected for application results.

scenarios.title: Move Applications
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can move one or more Application List Entries to another Application List.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to move one or more Application List Entries to another list so that workload can be managed flexibly.
scenarios.preCondition: One or more eligible Application List Entries are selected.

scenario.given: I have selected one or more Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Move Applications
and: I choose a target Application List, using the create an Application List steps from UAT 1 where needed
I review the Check your answers page
then: The selected applications are moved successfully
A success banner is displayed
The applications appear on the target list
The applications are no longer shown on the original list where applicable
Return to Applications takes me back with selections cleared

scenarios.title: Bulk Update Fee Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update fee details for multiple selected Application List Entries.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update fee details for multiple applications so that payment status can be managed efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application List Entries are selected and they all require a fee.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Update Fee Details
and: I enter Fee Status, Status Date, Payment Reference and Off Site Fee where required
then: The fee update is applied to the selected entries
A success banner is displayed
Validation prevents invalid fee status or date values
Return to Applications clears the selections

scenarios.title: Remove a Result
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can remove an incorrect result from an Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to remove an incorrect result so that the application outcome is accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An Application List Entry has at least one result recorded.

scenario.given: I expand the Result Wording accordion
scenario.when: I remove an existing result
then: The result is removed successfully
The result no longer appears in the Result Wording section
The Summary is updated
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Result Selected with Select All
scenarios.summary: Confirm Select All represents all matching applications when applying result actions across a result set.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need Select All to represent all matching applications so that I understand the scope of the result action.
scenarios.preCondition: Search results span more than one page.

scenario.given: I select all applications across the current result set
scenario.when: I open the Result Selected screen
then: The screen clearly indicates that all matching applications are selected
The table is replaced with an All summary where appropriate
The save action applies to the intended selected set
The selection scope is not confused with only the current page
